title: sokf harness hook answer
description: A `HookAnswer` is the answer that `sokf harness hook claude prompt-submit` prints on stdout, and that Codex and Factory Droid read in the same form: an empty object adds nothing, and `hookSpecificOutput` adds the note to the agent's context. Every other harness reads the answer in its own form.

anyOf.description: While errors remain, the note goes into the agent's context.
When no error remains, or the hook has already noted the same errors, the hook adds nothing.

NoteOutput.description: A `NoteOutput` holds the note and the event that it answers.

additionalContext.description: The note: `sokf:`, the number of errors, and `Fix before finishing the work.`

EventName.description: An `EventName` is the name of the event that the answer is for. Its only value is `UserPromptSubmit`.
